en.headline: Thunderstorm Warning extended until 1:45pm
en.dek: The Observatory prolonged the warning issued at 9:50am as isolated thunderstorms continued to affect Hong Kong, with heavier rain possible in some areas.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory extended the Thunderstorm Warning until 1:45pm on Monday after first issuing it at 9:50am. Isolated thunderstorms were expected over Hong Kong.

In a special weather tip at 11:45am, the Observatory said showers were continuing to affect the Pearl River Estuary area and that some districts could see heavier rain in the next one to two hours. Members of the public were advised to stay alert to weather changes.
When thunderstorms occur, people outdoors should seek safe shelter, leave the water and avoid outdoor swimming or water sports, and stay clear of high ground, conductive objects, trees or masts.

zh.headline: 雷暴警告延長至下午1時45分
zh.dek: 天文台上午9時50分發出的雷暴警告延長至下午1時45分，預料香港有局部地區雷暴，部分地區雨勢較大。
body: 香港天文台周一上午9時50分發出雷暴警告後，於11時05分宣布有效時間延長至今日下午1時45分，預料香港有局部地區雷暴。
天文台於上午11時45分發出特別天氣提示，指驟雨持續影響珠江口一帶，預料未來一兩小時本港部分地區雨勢較大，市民請留意天氣變化。
雷暴發生時，身處室外人士應到安全地方躲避，離開水面，切勿在戶外游泳或進行其他戶外水上運動，亦切勿站立於高地或接近導電物體、樹木或桅杆。
